$description: v0.13.2 — Theme-invariant color semantic additions. Mirrors the corresponding entries in `color.dark.tokens.json` + `color.light.tokens.json` for the keys that DON'T change between themes: `text.on-action`, `text.on-avatar`, `status.{tone}.border`. The chart palette + avatar palette are declared per-theme (in dark + light files) by convention so future per-theme tuning is possible without rearranging the namespace. The four status-border aliases close the validate:tokens gap where Alert, Banner, ValidationMessage component contracts referenced `color.status.{danger,info,success,warning}.border` without those paths existing anywhere.

on-action.$description: v0.13.2 — Text color when painted ON an action surface (primary button bg, action accent bg). Near-black `#07120D`, 14.7:1 AAA on Spring Green. Theme-invariant — the accent surface looks the same in both themes, so the foreground does too. Consume on primary `<button>` / accent-bg elements.

on-avatar.$description: v0.13.2 — Text color when painted ON an avatar fallback bg (initials, monogram). White at high contrast against any of the 8 avatar palette positions in `color.avatar.bg.*`.

status.$description: v0.13.2 — `border` alias for each of the four status tones. Routes through the existing primitive `color.status.{tone}.500` stops. Theme-invariant in v0.13.2 — future theme-specific tuning (lighter borders in light mode, etc.) can split these into the per-theme files without renaming the path.

border.$description: Danger border tone. Refined red #E5484D. Used by Alert / Banner / ValidationMessage / Field (error state).
Warning border tone. Refined amber #F5B118. Used by Alert / Banner / ValidationMessage / Field (warning state).
Success border tone. Spring Green per the single-accent rule (success rides the accent ramp). Used by Alert / Banner / ValidationMessage / Field (success state).
Info border tone. Cool-neutral / accent — info never gets a second loud color. Per ADR 0018 Premium Psychology contract.
